quickstart.md: CommerceLens links six business service repositories and owns their Compose orchestration.
application-overview.md: Order coordinates inventory reservation, payment and shipment, and emits confirmed-order events for Notification.
Order, Inventory and Notification own separate PostgreSQL databases.
service-catalog.md: Inventory owns product catalog and reservation storage; Payment and Shipping adapt HTTP providers without their own application databases.
dependencies.md: Portal proxies /api/notifications to Notification and other /api/ requests to Order.
Order calls Inventory, Payment and Shipping through HTTP.
data-and-events.md: Order persists confirmed orders and outbox rows transactionally and publishes order.confirmed events.
Notification tracks delivery attempts in PostgreSQL and consumes order.confirmed with a dead-letter queue.
checkout-flow.md: Checkout checkpoints payment_unknown before payment and treats only payment HTTP 402 as a definite decline.
Uncertain shipping failures retain payment and stock for manual_review; definite shipping rejection attempts refund and release.
